_about: Make-row category 'Plazas' (Core/Tool/Shelf.cs; one file per category). New 2026-10-28 (the user: "plazas is going to be its whole new category, because we're going to really outdo ourselves with that"; photos of a lifestyle centre's promenade and a dining plaza by a department store). The squares group (plaza, market square) and the shopping types built round a square or a pedestrian street (mall park, outdoor mall, high street, shopping plaza) are shown here; hide, never delete. See docs/refactor/STRIP-MALLS-PLAZAS.md. Designed plazas (2026-10-28, the user: "very intricate designed plazas ... think of Union Square"): the plaza shows six designed squares (grand square, garden rooms, railed gardens, terraced garden, modern plaza, old-town piazza; Core/Layers/Plaza/PlazaDesigns.cs); the classic compositions round the entrances (civic, fountain, cafe, sunken court, green) are hidden: big, mostly empty slabs next to them (docs/refactor/squares.md, 'Designed plazas'). Round 2 (2026-10-29, the user: "polish weak plazas ... I need more types also ... play a LOT more with terrain height"): five designed squares on their own ground are shown too (sunken plaza, market hall, dining terrace, grand stairs; Core/Layers/Plaza/PlazaDesigns.Squares.cs); water steps is hidden: the clean game has no water surface, its pools read as grey slabs. The plazas makeover (2026-10-29, docs/runbooks/plazas.md): every square gets a designed ground (Core/Decals/Dynamic/PlazaGround.cs: joints, stains, gum, leaves, worn lanes, puddles; the Wear choice is the setting) and a grungy square of its own (PlazaDesigns.Grungy); the amphitheatre (from Parks), the transit plaza (from Transport) and the fairground (from Shops) moved in and were rebuilt on the designed squares' kit: stone theatre, transit forecourt, summer fair and Christmas market; the market square is the designed market. Cut to the best: plaza piazza, railed, market hall and modern hidden (weaker twins of grand, rooms and the market square); the old amphitheatre styles, farmers market, taxi rank and station forecourt hidden; mall park hidden (a shops type round a park: its look depends on growth, not a square).
name: Plazas
